name: Kilo
tagline: Trims heavyweight Grok Bot setups so conversations cost less context
description: A cost-conscious maintainer for a growing bot collection. It measures how much conversational context each member of your setup drags along, flags the ones that have grown bloated, and rebuilds the worst offenders once you approve. A weekly message then names the next candidates so bloat never sneaks back.
author: Tchap248
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
